name: AI Due Diligence API
shortDescription: One-call token investment due diligence — composite score, red flags, bull/bear case, and confidence
description: Decision-layer due diligence for autonomous trading, portfolio, and research agents. Instead of separately calling holder-distribution, contract-safety, liquidity, and risk APIs, an agent submits a token and receives a single investment_score (0-100) with fundamental, on-chain, liquidity, and contract-safety sub-scores, severity-ranked red flags, bull and bear cases, catalysts, smart-money direction, a go/no-go verdict, and per-section confidence. Composes Orbis primitives (Token Holder Distribution, Honeypot Scanner, Token Trust, DeFi Risk) and returns chain_to pointers so agents can drill into any dimension. Conservative by design: unknowns lower the score and confidence rather than inflating them. Two latency profiles: POST /score (~5s) is the fast screening path returning scores, verdict and red flags for high-frequency loops; POST /lookup (~30s) is the deliberate deep call returning full rationales, bull/bear case and catalysts. Runs at temperature 0 for low-variance, repeatable scoring across calls.
